newsitem.title: MEXICO: Grupo Bancrecer '96 net 139.9 mln pesos.
newsitem.headline: Grupo Bancrecer '96 net 139.9 mln pesos.

text.p: Grupo Financiero Bancrecer reported on Thursday a net profit of 139.9 million pesos in 1996, 376.2 percent higher than in 1995.

It said in a statement that its banking subsidiary, Bancrecer S.A., had reported a net loss of 732.9 million pesos in 1996, mainly due to accumulation of reserves. That compared to a 1995 loss of 162.0 million pesos, it said.
Grupo Financiero Bancrecer said that 1996 revenues were 735.5 million pesos, compared with expenses of 595.6 million.
It added that it had built its reserves by 1.3 billion pesos during the year, which once taken into account, would give it a net loss of 627.8 million pesos in 1996.
That compares to a net loss of 261.5 million for 1995.
The company said that in the fourth quarter of 1996 its subsidairies Bancrecer and BanOro built reserves of 973.4 million.
The subsidiary BanOro posted a 1996 net loss of 23.7 million pesos, compared to a net loss of 93.3 million pesos in 1995.
Bancrecer had a capitalisation ratio of 9.77 percent at year end 1996, compared with 9.9 percent in December 1995, it said.
